summary: The composer and the posting pages as SwiftUI screens.

src/posting/PostingSettingsSection.jsx.note: Whose settings (every signed-in account, and the open one even when it needs a sign-in, by accountName with its @handle) when there is more than one, then the cards over that account's PostingSettingsModel (usePostingSettings), made again for another account: New posts, and with a long session the Weekly queue, the Default timer and the Post adviser. Not yet: the Post adviser's settings (AdviserSettings.jsx: its heading and that it isn't in the app yet) and, for an account without a long session, NeedsBackend.jsx (that it isn't in the app yet).

src/posting/composer/Composer.jsx.note: Ported: opening from an intent (normalizeIntent, seedFromIntent, setting aside what was being written, the notices), restoring what was kept (keptPostFor, takeSetAside, openAside, elsewhereNotices), loading a reply or a quote, posting as another account (changeAsDid, gatesForAccount), the default reply settings, adding pictures (picked, pasted, an intent's described ones) and a video (uploaded as soon as it's added), quotes and link cards found in the text, splitting, renumbering and its undo, removing and adding posts, the settings row (tags, language, replies, timer, More › Continue a thread and Start over), a "/" template applied over its shortcut (applyTemplate, applyPlan: its text and what it attaches), Continue a thread (the archive's posts, else the author feed), the phone's bar at the top (Close, the title and the send button, 640 and under), the busy line, the slow and hard publish watch, publishErrorView, the posted toast and resetting after a send, the autosave (flushed on Close and when the app goes to the background). Publishing goes through ComposerPublisher (VirgaUI/Composer/ComposerServices.swift); until publish.js's port is wired, UnavailablePublisher shows the web's busy line and then says publishing isn't in the iOS app yet, and Schedule, Add to queue and Save as draft do the same. Link cards come through ComposerLinkCards, a stand-in for linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard over the session's transport. Not yet, because what they call isn't ported: scheduling and the weekly queue (WhenPicker, the queue's next slot, submitSchedule), drafts (saveDraft, loading a draft or a scheduled post, the draft media store, finishSource), the timer (LifespanEditor, getLimits, the default timer, armAfterPublish), the adviser (Check this post, the gate before posting), the library's panel (LibraryDialog: a template with blanks to fill says the library isn't in the iOS app yet), Save as a template (TemplateEditor), the duplicate guard (publish.js's), drag and drop, and the posted toast's View it on Bluesky link (the shell's toasts are words only).

src/posting/composer/ComposerDialogs.jsx.note: ConfirmDialog, MetaDialog, GatesDialog, VideoAltDialog and ContinueThreadDialog are ported. LifespanDialog says the timer isn't in the iOS app yet (LifespanEditor.jsx isn't ported).

src/posting/composer/LanguagePicker.jsx.note: Return adds the first suggestion; a hardware keyboard's arrows don't move through them.

src/posting/composer/PostBlock.jsx.note: PostTools' library button (Quote or attach from your library) waits for the library's port; pictures and a video come from PhotosPicker.

src/posting/composer/PostEditor.jsx.note: The highlights are attributes on a UITextView's own text rather than a layer under a transparent textarea. The "/" templates come from Library.detectSlashCommand, rankTemplatesForSlash and PostTemplates.matchShortcut. Not yet: the slash list's Open the library (the library's panel isn't ported), and a hardware keyboard's arrows (and Escape) through the mention and template suggestions.

src/posting/composer/TagsField.jsx.note: Backspace in an empty field doesn't take the last tag off (SwiftUI's TextField doesn't say when it's pressed).

src/posting/library/TemplateEditor.jsx.note: The editor as a full-height sheet, its foot held under the form: the note, a seed's note, Name, Text with Insert (A blank… and the four context inserts) and its count against 300, naming a new blank in place (Add, Don’t add a blank), the hint; Questions for each blank asked (its key, Question and Example or hint side by side from 640 wide, Typed answer or Pick from a list, the choices one per line, Optional) and what fills itself; Attach (Nothing, One of your posts with the recent ones five at a time and Show more, A link with Read the link; what it attaches named, Gone, the other kind kept with Remove it); Offer it when; Group and Shortcut; Suggest it when a post mentions; the server's refusal (with Sign in again for a permission) and the fields' own; and the foot: Delete, Cancel, Save template, or Discard your changes? / Delete … for good? in its place, Escape putting a prompt away. Saved through TemplatesModel with its toasts. The editor's reads are the library's (LibrarySources.fetchOwnPosts, hydrateEmbedViews, resolveRecordLink, resolveExternalLink), a web page's card through the composer's stand-in for linkCard.js's fetchLinkCard (ComposerLinkCards). Not yet: the caret (SwiftUI's text editor doesn't give it on iOS 17, so Insert and a blank go at the end of the text); the groups already used offered under Group (a datalist). A swipe down is held while there are changes.

src/posting/library/TemplateQuestions.js.note: TemplateQuestions (a field per typed question, ChoiceGroup per choice question with the arrows, Home and End and choosing again to clear an optional one, · optional, the hint and note, Answer this one first., Return going to the next unanswered question, the count of those still to answer read out), ChoiceGroup and TemplatePreview (Your post / Your reply will read, the count against 300, added words, what fills itself underlined, answers on the accent's tint, blanks to answer, the attachment's card, the notes and what stops it). The preview is the caller's, or the library's previewFor (VirgaPosting's Library.previewFor) for a template on its own (its words into an empty post, nothing attached); the composer's library passes its own, within the post under way.

src/posting/pages/TemplatesPage.jsx.note: The page over the account's own TemplatesModel (useTemplates) and TemplateUsage (readTemplateUsage, sortTemplatesForShelf): the permission notice with Sign in again when the sign-in can't write templates; the read-again failure over the last ones seen; the bones while the first read runs; the failure with Try again; No templates yet with New template; then the count and its line with New template, the groups (Other templates for those without one), and each row: the name as the way into the editor with its /shortcut, Use and the ⋯ (Edit, Delete with its dialog and toast) on the name's line, the words with each blank marked (named as it is asked, or as it fills itself; No text: it only attaches something), and the facts (who it's for, the questions, what it attaches, the words that suggest it, how often it was used here). The editor is TemplateEditor. Use opens the composer (ComposerHost) with the template's intent; the composer reads the template once library/model.js is ported. iOS additions: /posting/templates/new and /posting/templates/<rkey> open the editor. A blank's chip is drawn on a tint in the run of words; the focus after a delete is the system's.

src/posting/pages/hubParts.jsx.note: RowSkeleton, LoadError and ConfirmDialog (busy, and a refusal's message kept in the dialog). The rest (the post rows, the posting nav, the long-session notice) come with the pages that use them.

src/posting/pages/scheduleParts.jsx.note: TimezoneSelect (TimezonePicker: this device's zone first, then the rest, an unknown stored zone kept) and SwitchButton (SettingsSwitch), as Settings › Posting uses them. The rest comes with the scheduling pages.

src/posting/ui/AltTextDialog.jsx.note: The writer's part: the image, its description and the count. Describing and revising it for the writer needs the adviser's AI service (aiService.js, altTextModel.js, altTextFollowUp.js), not ported; the web shows no Generate button without a server requester either. ALT_TEXT_MAX_GRAPHEMES is written here until altTextModel.js's port.

src/posting/ui/ComposerDefaults.jsx.note: New posts: Languages (the composer's LanguagePicker, which names itself above its tokens), Who can reply and quote (My Bluesky setting or Choose here, with the composer's GatesEditor over the stored gates), Main button (PublishActions' four, normalized), Require alt text, Offer to split long posts and Number the posts of a split thread as switches, each saved as it changes, with a refused change's message under them.

src/posting/ui/LifespanDefaults.jsx.note: Default timer: Start new posts with a timer (its hint when off), the rule in a sentence (describeTimer), under the row when on and behind The rule it will use: … when off, saved never pinned to a time, the refusal, and the caption with See posts on a timer. Not yet: the rule's editor (LifespanEditor.jsx), whose place says it isn't in the app yet, and the timers in use (scheduleService.js's getLimits and timerLimitsLine), so the caption starts at its second sentence as the web's does when the limits can't be read.

src/posting/ui/PostPreview.jsx.note: Only the compact form the composer uses (who wrote it and its words), read straight from the view: postPreview.js isn't ported, so there's no time, embed line or counts.

src/posting/ui/PostingHeader.jsx.note: The header's model (Posting in the crumbs except on the overview, the page's title and line, what it touches, or not), used by Templates and every posting page not here yet. Not yet: a caller's own crumbs, title, line, actions and children.

src/posting/ui/QueueSettings.jsx.note: Weekly queue: the posting times a week with the week in a line and Edit the week (to Posting › Weekly schedule), the time zone (this device's first, then every zone the device knows) with the device's zone named when it differs, and Suggest posting times. scheduleModel.js's weeklyCount, weekSummary, slotLabel, zoneLabel and moveToZone are written beside it (ScheduleWords) until the scheduling pages' model is ported; TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers stands in for Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').

src/posting/ui/SettingsParts.jsx.note: SettingsCard and SettingsRow are Settings' own SettingsSectionView and SettingsRow (a block row's control on a line of its own; a short control kept on the label's line on a phone).
